ingredients.name: chicken breasts, skinless, cooked and diced (about 2 cups)
lettuce leaves, Bibb, romaine, or green or red leaf

steps.instruction: Cut 2 red apples in quarters.
Remove the cores and chop the apples.
Put the apples, 2 diced celery stalks and 2 diced cooked chicken breasts in a bowl.
steps.spoken: Put the apples, 2 diced celery stalks and 2 skinless, cooked, diced chicken breasts in a medium bowl. That is about 2 cups of chicken.

steps.instruction: Add 1/4 cup each of yogurt and mayonnaise and 1/2 cup of raisins.
Add 1/4 teaspoon of salt and 1/8 teaspoon of black pepper.
Mix everything in the bowl well.
Arrange 16 lettuce leaves on plates and top with the salad.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Tennessee State University Cooperative Extension Service

steps.instruction: Mix 1 cup of applesauce, 1/4 cup of dry milk powder and 1 cup of water in a bowl.
Mix in 2 eggs and 1 tablespoon of canola oil.
Add 2 cups of flour and 2 tablespoons of sugar.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon and 2 teaspoons of baking powder.
Stir until the mixture has only small lumps.
Place a large skillet on medium-high heat.
Spray the skillet with cooking spray.
Pour 1/2 cup of batter onto the skillet.
Turn the pancake when bubbles form on top.
Cook the other side for about 1 minute, until golden brown.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Texas AgriLife Extension, Expanded Nutrition Program - Hidalgo County

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 350 °F.
Mix 3 cups of oatmeal, 1/2 cup of coconut and 1 cup of pecans in a large bowl.
Mix in 1/4 cup of honey, 1/4 cup of liquid margarine and 1 1/2 teaspoons of cinnamon.
Spread the mixture in a 13x9 inch baking pan.
Bake for 25 minutes, until golden brown.
steps.spoken: Bake for 25 to thirty minutes, until golden brown. Stir every five minutes.

steps.instruction: Stir in 2/3 cup of raisins.
Cool the granola thoroughly.
Store the granola in a tightly covered container.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Adapted from Sure To Please Baked Eggs and Cheese, Healthy Snacks, University of Wisconsin Cooperative Extension Service

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 350 °F.
Put 1 tablespoon of oil in a medium baking dish or small cake pan.
Heat the dish in the oven for a few minutes.
Beat 6 eggs in a medium bowl.
Mix 1/2 cup of milk and 1/2 cup of grated cheese into the eggs.
Mix 1 teaspoon of garlic powder and 1 1/2 teaspoons of oregano into the eggs.
Pour the egg mixture into the hot dish.
Bake for 20 minutes, until the eggs are firm.
steps.spoken: Bake for 20 minutes, or until the eggs are firm. Serve right away.

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: A Harvest of Recipes with USDA Foods, USDA Food Distribution Program on Indian Reservations, Adapted from a recipe by Trista Winnett, Choctaw Nation

steps.instruction: Bring 6 cups of water to a boil in a large pot over medium to high heat.
Add 4 to 6 handfuls of corn shucks to the boiling water.
steps.spoken: Add 4 to 6 handfuls of corn shucks to the boiling water. Boil the corn shucks for about 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Remove the corn shucks carefully.
Strip a few shucks into strings.
Tie two strings together to make longer strings.
Mix 2 cups of cornmeal, 1 teaspoon of baking soda and 1 teaspoon of salt in a bowl.
Keep mixing and slowly add a little water, until the mixture is firm enough to handle.
Form the mixture into 8 oval balls about 3 inches long.
Wrap the balls in corn shucks.
Tie the ends closed with the corn shuck strings.
Gently put the wrapped balls into the large pot of boiling water.
steps.spoken: The pot should be about two thirds full of water.

steps.instruction: Cover the pot and cook over medium to high heat for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the pot with a lid and cook over medium to high heat for 30 to forty-five minutes.

steps.instruction: Remove the corn shuck wrapping from each ball.

ingredients.name: vegetables, chopped, such as broccoli, zucchini or mushrooms

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375 °F.
Shred 1/2 cup of cheese with a grater.
Put the cheese in a small bowl for now.
Chop the vegetables until you have 1 cup.
Cook the chopped vegetables until cooked, but still crisp.
Put the cooked vegetables and the cheese into the pie crust.
Mix 3 beaten eggs and 1 cup of fat-free milk in a bowl.
Mix in 1/2 teaspoon each of salt, ground black pepper and garlic powder.
Pour the egg mixture over the cheese and vegetables.
Bake for 30 minutes, until a knife near the center comes out clean.
steps.spoken: Bake for 30 to forty minutes, until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean.

steps.instruction: Let the quiche cool for 5 minutes before serving.
Chop 1 onion.
Sauté the chopped onion in a pan until soft.
Set the onion aside for a while.
Melt 5 tablespoons of butter in a pan.
Add 7 tablespoons of flour to the butter.
Stir the flour over medium heat until the mixture is dark brown.
steps.spoken: Cook the flour over medium heat until the mixture is dark brown.

steps.instruction: Whisk in 4 1/4 cups of bouillon a little at a time.
steps.spoken: Add the 4 1/4 cups of bouillon in small batches while whisking.

steps.instruction: Let the sauce boil until it thickens.
steps.spoken: Let the sauce boil and thicken for a few minutes.

steps.instruction: Add the onion back to the sauce.
Grind some black pepper into the sauce.
steps.spoken: Grind some black pepper into the sauce. You can also add meat of your choice, or use the sauce as it is.

bulgur-veggie-chickpea-salad.title: Bulgur Wheat, Veggie and Chickpea Salad

source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: 5 A Day Bulger Wheat, Choices: Steps Toward Health, University of Massachusetts Extension Nutrition Education Program

ingredients.name: green pepper, chopped (or red or yellow pepper)

steps.instruction: Wash and chop 1 medium onion and 1 small green pepper.
Wash and chop 1 cup of broccoli and shred 1 cup of carrots.
Wash and chop 1/3 cup of fresh parsley.
Heat 1 teaspoon of canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until soft.
Add 1 1/2 cups of dry bulgur and stir to coat.
Add 2 cups of low-sodium chicken broth.
Bring the skillet to a boil.
Lower the heat.
Add the broccoli, carrots, green pepper and 1 cup of chickpeas.
steps.spoken: Add the broccoli, carrots, green pepper and 1 cup of drained chickpeas. Cook for 10 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed.

steps.instruction: Stir in the parsley.
steps.spoken: Stir in the parsley. Serve warm or cold.

steps.instruction: Serve warm or cold.

chicken-red-wine-vinegar-sauce.title: Chicken in Red Wine Vinegar Sauce

ingredients.name: whole chicken, cut into 10 pieces (or use breasts or legs)

steps.instruction: Rub each piece of chicken with salt and pepper.
Heat 3 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon of butter in a 12-inch sauté pan.
steps.spoken: Heat 3 tablespoons of oil and 1 tablespoon of butter in a 12-inch sauté pan. Heat the oil and melt the butter in a deep-sided, 12-inch sauté pan over medium-high heat. Wait until the oil is hot, but not smoking.

steps.instruction: Lay the chicken pieces in the pan, skin side down.
steps.spoken: Use tongs to lay the chicken pieces in the pan, skin side down. Brown both sides for about 12 to fifteen minutes.

steps.instruction: Brown both sides until the skin is golden brown.
steps.spoken: Brown both sides until the skin is golden brown and a thermometer reads 165 °F in the thickest part of the chicken.

steps.instruction: Move the chicken to a platter and cover loosely with aluminum foil.
Pour out half of the oil from the pan.
Add 4 chopped shallots and brown them in the oil over medium-high heat.
Slowly add 1 cup of red wine vinegar.
Boil until the vinegar is reduced to almost a syrup.
Add 1 cup of creme fraiche or heavy cream and cook for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of creme fraiche or heavy cream and cook for 5 minutes. Add the creme fraiche or cream and cook for about 5 minutes, until it is blended and brown.

steps.instruction: Return the chicken to the pan to coat and heat it.
Put the chicken back on the platter and add parsley if you like.
Heat 2 teaspoons of oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add 1 pound of the chicken and cook 3 minutes, until brown.
steps.spoken: Add half of the chicken, 1 pound, and cook for 3 minutes, until brown.

steps.instruction: Take the chicken out of the pan and set it aside.
Add the other 1 pound of chicken and cook 3 minutes, until brown.
steps.spoken: Add the rest of the chicken, 1 pound, and cook for 3 minutes, until brown.

steps.instruction: Remove the chicken and add the other 1 teaspoon of oil to the pan.
Add 2 teaspoons of garlic, 1/2 cup of onion and 1 tablespoon of ginger.
steps.spoken: Add 2 teaspoons of garlic, 1/2 cup of onion and 1 tablespoon of ginger. Lower the heat to medium and stir constantly for 5 minutes, until soft.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper, 1 teaspoon of cumin and 1 teaspoon of turmeric.
steps.spoken: Stir in 1/2 teaspoon of cayenne pepper, 1 teaspoon of cumin and 1 teaspoon of turmeric. Saute for 1 minute.

steps.instruction: Stir in 1/2 cup of chicken stock and 1 can (19 ounces) of stewed tomatoes.
Stir in 2 tablespoons of tomato paste and 1 teaspoon of sugar.
Return the chicken to the pan and bring it to a boil.
Lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Stir in 3/4 cup of plain yogurt and simmer for 2 minutes.
steps.spoken: Stir in 3/4 cup of low fat plain yogurt and simmer for 2 minutes.

steps.instruction: Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a large pot.
Add 2 cups of chopped onion and 2 cloves of chopped garlic.
Add 2 cups of peeled, chopped sweet potatoes and 1/2 cup of chopped celery.
Sauté for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Sauté the onion, garlic, sweet potatoes and celery for about 5 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 2 teaspoons of paprika, 1 teaspoon of turmeric and 1 teaspoon of basil.
Add 1 teaspoon of salt and 1 dash each of cinnamon and cayenne.
Add 1 bay leaf and 3 cups of stock or water.
Simmer with the lid on for 15 minutes.
Add 1 cup of chopped tomatoes and 3/4 cup of chopped sweet peppers.
Add 1 1/2 cups of cooked chickpeas and 1 tablespoon of tamari soy sauce.
Simmer for 10 minutes, until the vegetables are as tender as you like.
steps.spoken: Simmer for about 10 minutes, until all the vegetables are as tender as you like them.

steps.instruction: Peel 1 inch of fresh ginger and cut it into small pieces.
Crush the ginger and 10 cardamom seeds.
Bring 4 cups of water to a boil.
Turn off the stove.
Add the crushed ginger and cardamom seeds to the water.
Add 2 tablespoons of black tea and 1 1/2 cups of milk.
Cover the pot and let the tea steep for 5 minutes.
steps.spoken: Cover the pot and let the tea steep for 5 to ten minutes.

steps.instruction: Serve with 1 teaspoon of sugar per cup.
steps.spoken: Serve with 1 teaspoon of sugar per cup. You may want to strain the tea, or let the bits settle to the bottom of the cups.

steps.instruction: Cut 1 pound of sausage into sticks.
Dice 1 yellow onion.
Fry the sausage and onion in 1 tablespoon of olive oil for 10 minutes.
steps.spoken: Fry the sausage sticks and diced onion in 1 tablespoon of olive oil for about 10 minutes.

steps.instruction: Add 4 tablespoons of tomato purée and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in 1 cup of cream and 7 tablespoons of milk.
Stir in 1 tablespoon each of soy sauce and Dijon mustard.
Simmer for at least 5 minutes.
Season with plenty of pepper, and salt if you like.
steps.spoken: Season with plenty of pepper, and maybe some salt, to taste.

steps.instruction: Combine 1 cup of flour, 1 tablespoon of sugar and 1 tablespoon of cinnamon in a bowl.
Add 1/2 teaspoon of baking powder and 1 pinch of salt.
Separate 1 egg.
Add the egg yolk to the dry ingredients.
Whisk the egg white until foamy.
Slice 1 large peeled apple into thin strips.
steps.spoken: Slice 1 large peeled apple into thin strips. You can also grate the apple.

steps.instruction: Mix in the apple, 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract, the egg white and 2/3 cup of milk.
steps.spoken: Mix the dry ingredients, the apple, 1 teaspoon of vanilla extract, the egg white and 2/3 cup of milk into an even batter.

steps.instruction: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add about 3 tablespoons of batter for each pancake.
steps.spoken: Add about 3 tablespoons of batter for each pancake. Cook for 2 minutes on the first side.

steps.instruction: Flip the pancake and cook the other side for 2 minutes.
Repeat with the rest of the batter, for 8 pancakes in all.

spinach-raisins-pine-nuts.title: Spinach with Raisins and Pine Nuts

steps.instruction: Cook and stir 1/4 cup of pine nuts in a medium pan over high heat.
steps.spoken: Cook and stir 1/4 cup of pine nuts in a medium pan over high heat. Cook and stir the pine nuts until they begin to brown lightly and smell toasted, but not burnt.

steps.instruction: Set the pine nuts aside in another dish.
Return the pan to medium-high heat and add 1/4 cup of water.
Add a small handful of spinach as the water begins to boil.
steps.spoken: Cook and stir just until the spinach begins to wilt.

steps.instruction: Push the spinach to the side of the pan.
Add another 1/4 cup of water and another handful of spinach.
Repeat with the rest of the spinach, adding 2/3 cup of raisins with the last handful.
steps.spoken: Keep adding a handful of spinach at a time until all 20 ounces of spinach have gone in. Add the 2/3 cup of raisins with the last handful.

steps.instruction: Sprinkle 1/8 teaspoon each of nutmeg and salt over the spinach.
Cook and stir until all the spinach is wilted and the raisins are warm.
Remove the pan from the heat and press out the extra water.
Place 1 cup of the spinach and raisins in a serving bowl.
Top it with the pine nuts.

ingredients.name: very hot water, or as directed on the package

steps.instruction: Soak 2 cups of cracked wheat in 2 cups of very hot water for 30 minutes.
steps.spoken: Soak 2 cups of cracked wheat in 2 cups of very hot water, until the water is absorbed. This takes about 30 minutes.

steps.instruction: Drain any extra water and squeeze the wheat dry.
Combine the wheat, 1 chopped cucumber and 2 small chopped tomatoes in a bowl.
Add 1 bunch of sliced green onions and 1/2 cup of chopped mint.
Add 2 cups of chopped parsley and 1 clove of minced garlic.
Mix 1/2 cup of lemon juice and 3/4 cup of olive oil in a small bowl.
Add 1 tablespoon of pepper and 2 teaspoons of salt.
Stir the dressing into the salad mix.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.

tuscan-beans-with-tomatoes.title: Tuscan Beans with Tomatoes and Oregano

ingredients.name: low-sodium chickpeas, 15 1/2 ounces, drained and rinsed
fresh oregano, minced, or 1 teaspoon dried
romaine lettuce leaves, inner, rinsed and dried

steps.instruction: Combine 1 can of chickpeas and 2 cups of cherry tomatoes in a large salad bowl.
In a small bowl, mix 1 tablespoon of olive oil and 1 teaspoon of balsamic vinegar.
Add 2 tablespoons of oregano, 1/8 teaspoon of pepper and 1/2 teaspoon of seasoning blend.
Whisk until the oil and vinegar no longer separate.
steps.spoken: Whisk with a wire whisk until it blends into one thick sauce, and the oil and vinegar no longer separate.

steps.instruction: Pour the dressing over the beans and tomatoes and mix gently to coat.
Line each of four salad bowls with romaine lettuce leaves, 1 per bowl.
Top each leaf with one-fourth of the bean mixture and serve.
